rationale: A has a more distinctive editorial art direction (warm cream, high-contrast serif with orange italic accents, a dark ledger card) and a strong sticky scroll story where the Request/Authorize/Post/Settle steps drive a progressively lit flow diagram. B's staggered blur-in hero entrance is better choreographed than A's, whose first frames jump from blank to fully settled. But B's dark-and-lime look is more generic, it leaves a large empty void around scrollY 6750, and on mobile two customer quotes overlap into illegible text. Hover feedback is comparable: A uses underlines and lifted shadows, B uses pill fills and a lime glow.
